candidates.definition_line: Cross-current output, brilliance made of what it meets
candidates.face_teaser: You dazzle when you break form. The same spark that wins the crowd can unsettle the ones who run it. You’d rather be brilliant than merely correct, and often you’re both. The craft is aiming it where invention is wanted, not just where rules happen to be.
candidates.family_clause: how you meet and remake the world

family_element.appetite: brilliance, invention, and expression that bends the rules
family_element.notAlone: not talent alone, but everything you shape and send outward

__ore.note: TG corpus — the K2 generation source (kept per REA_03 §2.4)

rulingRealm.phrase: Rebellion Logic — output that structurally exceeds its container
rulingRealm.desc: 伤官者，聪明秀气太过: "Hurting Officer people are excessively brilliant and refined." The excess is structural, not attitudinal — the intelligence genuinely exceeds the frameworks available to receive it, so it pushes against them as a side effect of expressing itself.

gifts: Genuine structural advancement — the work moves something forward in ways people working within convention cannot produce
The brilliance is sharpened by exactly what resists it; the friction is part of the mechanism that makes the output what it is
Authentic creative authority that comes from having actually exceeded the available framework
shadows: 伤官见官，为祸百端: in structural tension with any authority that tries to evaluate the output by conventional standards
Self-destruction when the output has nowhere adequate to land: the force that produces breakthroughs turns inward
The brilliance and the difficulty are inseparable — improving the one without the other is not available
__ore.hiddenDynamic: The specific interior cost that goes mostly unspoken: knowing you've just broken something that can't be unbroken — in a conversation, in a relationship — and not being certain whether that was necessary or excessive. The brilliance and the destruction arrived together.

outputs.desc: Your work moves something genuinely forward in ways people working within convention cannot produce.
Your brilliance is sharpened by exactly what resists it — the friction is part of what makes the output what it is.
Your creative authority is real because you've actually exceeded the framework, not merely worked inside it.

frictions.desc: You're in structural tension with any authority that tries to judge your output by conventional standards.
When the output has nowhere adequate to land, the force that produces breakthroughs turns back on you.
The brilliance and the difficulty are inseparable; improving one without the other isn't on offer.

career.mechanism: 伤官 → innovation, disruption, structural advancement beyond convention
career.text: Exceptional in roles requiring genuine creative innovation or disruption — entrepreneurship, research, independent creative practice. Deeply unsuited to politically managed hierarchies where 伤官见官 produces constant institutional friction.

relationships.mechanism: 伤官 → intensity, friction as intimacy, container requirements
relationships.text: Others are drawn to the brilliance and encounter the friction as inseparable from it. The relationships that hold are those that can contain the full force. Intensity deepens some relationships and exhausts others.

wealth.mechanism: 伤官 → edge output seeking adequate container, timing critical
wealth.text: Can generate significant wealth when the output finds the right market or moment. The risk: the output is structurally ahead of what current audiences can receive, so timing is everything.

health.mechanism: 伤官 → internal pressure when output has no channel, DM element depleted
health.text: When the output has nowhere to land, the friction turns inward. The body bears the cost of sustained structural tension between what is produced and what the environment can receive.

retired_2026-09-20_evaluation_rulings.definition_line: Cross-current output — brilliance made of what it meets

helping.ahead: You become more outspoken in these years, and the people who like it like it a great deal. You gather an audience of your own, and you lose patience with company that asks you to be quieter.
helping.lived: In company you were the lively one in those years, quick with a joke and a sharp opinion. People sought you out for the spark, and you enjoyed being heard.

heavy.lived: Your sharp tongue cost you friends in those years, and a few groups closed ranks against you. You kept the people who liked your honesty, and those few saw you through.
heavy.ahead: Bluntness strains your friendships in these years, and some people take offence at what you meant as wit. The friends who stay value your candour, and you find them worth more than a wide circle.

helping.ahead: You turn your thinking outward in these years, and you say in public what you used to keep to yourself. You are quicker and bolder with ideas than at any time before.
helping.lived: Ideas came fast in those years, and you spoke them aloud with confidence. You were quicker than the people around you, and you enjoyed proving it in argument.

heavy.lived: Restless thinking ran through those years, and you argued with every idea that came from above. Your mind never settled, and what carried you was one project worth all that energy.
heavy.ahead: Your thoughts run hot in these years, and every rule you meet invites a quarrel. Work that uses the energy keeps you clear, and you sleep better on the days you finish something.

helping.lived: Talent made your name in those years, through work that broke with how things were usually done. You stood out for being different, and the people who hired you wanted exactly that.
helping.ahead: Original work brings you recognition in these ten years. You win clients and audiences by doing what others will not, and your reputation grows on your own terms.

heavy.lived: Clashes with bosses marked those years, because you said aloud what others kept quiet. You lost favour more than once, and your skill carried you to the next job each time.
heavy.ahead: Authority pushes back on you in these years, and a frank remark costs more than it used to. Work that is yours alone carries you through, and you do better outside a strict chain of command.
